jobs.title: Portfolio Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:

Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices nationwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.
We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a  Portfolio Marketing Specialist  to join our Marketing team.
CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for projects, team meetings, or trainings.
ABOUT THE FIRM
CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices nationwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.
YOUR TEAM.
Reporting to the Portfolio Marketing Manager, the Marketing Specialist executes high-impact marketing activities and supports integrated portfolio marketing programs that strengthen market visibility, drive engagement and lead generation, and connect marketing execution to industry and service-line growth priorities. The successful Marketing Specialist will be well versed in project management, campaign coordination across owned, earned, and paid channels, and stakeholder collaboration with practice professionals, business development, and marketing teams to keep initiatives moving from planning through execution and performance reporting.

At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
YOUR ROLE.
Responsibilities include but not limited to:
- Support execution of integrated portfolio marketing programs, which include market research, digital marketing, sponsorships and events, content marketing, referral marketing, and targeted campaigns that advance visibility, engagement, and pipeline development.
- Maintain campaign plans, timelines, calendars, and trackers in Monday.com and related systems to ensure project visibility, deadline accountability, and alignment across marketing, business development, and practice stakeholders. in Monday.com, trackers
- Coordinate internally with other marketing teams, practice professionals, business development team members, and external vendors as needed to deliver content, list management, management, association coordination, advertising, public relations, and digital marketing initiatives efficiently and on brand.

- Collaborate with CohnReznick’s events team to ensure seamless webinar, trade show, sponsorship and hosted event coordination and logistics support; help track follow-up activities and update prospect, COI, and client lists in CRM.

- Monitor progress, risks, next steps, and stakeholder responsibilities for active marketing initiatives, providing timely updates that keep projects on deadline and accountable to agreed objectives.

- Support internal marketing efforts by engaging industry and service line teams to support campaign activities, including driving engagement on social media and to events.
- Coordinate the review and approval processes to deliver marketing and sales collateral, and webpages; utilize our Digital Asset Management (DAM) system to maintain collateral including sell sheets, sales tools, datasheets, client references, web pages and case studies.

- Support contract management, invoicing, budget tracking, CRM updates, DAM maintenance, and campaign performance reporting to help measure marketing effectiveness and maintain accurate operational records.

YOUR EXPERIENCE.
The successful candidate will have:
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
- 2+ years of professional services work experience; accounting, law or consulting firm experience a plus.
- Understanding of B2B marketing required, experience with professional services marketing preferred.
- Strong project coordination, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
- Self-starter with an inquisitive mindset and the demonstrated ability to work independently and confidently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the proven ability to juggle multiple tasks with multiple stakeholders.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- A team player who can collaborate effectively with marketing and client service professionals at all levels of the organization.
- Superior Microsoft Office skills; familiarity with CRM platforms, Microsoft Teams, Marketing Automation, webinar platforms, and Marketing Project Management (e.g., Marketo, Microsoft Dynamics, Monday.com, On24) a plus.
- Copilot or other LLM experience, and willing to leverage LLMs

At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.

Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Senior Associate  to join the  M&A Insurance Advisory team.
CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.
YOUR TEAM.
This position will support our M&A Insurance Advisory practice. This group provides a wide suite of services to clients, giving you the opportunity to learn, grow, and build out your skills. As a member of this team, you’ll interact with team members across all levels within the practice.
WHY COHNREZNICK?
At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
YOUR ROLE.
Responsibilities include but not limited to:
- Support Value360’s growing M&A Insurance Advisory practice
- Review financial due diligence reports, acquisition agreements, and representation and warranty insurance (RWI) policies
- Facilitate virtual interviews with technical accounting experts and diligence providers
- Effectively communicate diligence findings in written deliverables, clearly articulating the basis for any recommendations
- Provide timely and comprehensive responses to clients regarding accounting and valuation considerations
- Conduct GAAP research

The successful candidate will have:
- Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
- 3+ years of experience providing financial/accounting due diligence
- CPA preferred but not required
- CFF or CFE designations are a plus.
- Experience assessing the sufficiency of financial diligence procedures in the context of mergers and acquisitions.
- Significant case experience regarding complex transactions and accounting considerations.
- Experience managing multiple complex engagements simultaneously.
- Excellent analytical and organizational skills.
- Significant flexibility of work schedule to meet client needs.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and root cause determination skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to lead a team in a deadline-driven environment. A natural self-starter and independent thinker.
- Action-oriented, decisive approach, with the willingness to take a hands-on role to ensure the deliverables are met on time with high quality.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Strong attention to detail with the ability to work independently.
